versions.changelog:
Version 0.5.0 of rabbit-readme-improver

- Overhauled README-writing approach to follow conventions measured from 100 trending GitHub repositories—not generic advice.
- Explicitly supports multiple modes: draft, audit (review), restructure, and section editing, with clear triggers and outputs.
- Documents section ordering and content guidelines based on real, measured patterns (not personal preference) from popular repos.
- Details specific craft guidelines for clarity, conciseness, badge usage, and communication style, all backed by corpus statistics.
- Adds guidance for handling badges, centering header blocks, linking conventions, and when to include tables of contents based on document length and real-world usage.
- References in-repo resources for methodology, patterns, and automated checklist review.
